name: 新しいグループの会話開始カード
prompt:
Refine the Japanese UI screenshot while preserving the exact 390×354 component canvas, text, proportions, layout, spacing, positions, and rounded geometry shown in the native preview. Use the v002 candidate as the base for its improved alignment; use the native preview as the source of truth for geometry and wording. The original English crop is reference context only; do not copy its English text or artwork.

User-directed color correction: remove every tinted surface and green accent. The card, avatar disc, and both pill buttons must all be plain white (#FFFFFF) with only a thin neutral light-gray outline (#E8ECE9). No mint, green, pastel, gradient, shadow, or colored surface fill. The avatar character 光 should be dark neutral (#1D1D1D), not green. Button labels メンバーを追加 and リンクやコードで招待 should be dark neutral (#1D1D1D), not green. The standalone text action 説明を追加 must be blue (#1976D2) to read as the hyperlink, as the user explicitly requested; it is the only colored text.

Preserve the established positions and sizes: card x24 y8 w342 h330; avatar circle x164 y24 w62 h62; title box near x40 y116 w310 h28; subtitle near x40 y156 w310 h24; hyperlink near x40 y198 w310 h24; first button x40 y244 w310 h32; second button x40 y290 w310 h32. Keep the existing Japanese strings exact and centered as shown. Use clean Meiryo-like Japanese sans-serif text, bold for the main heading and hyperlink, regular for the subtitle, and compact regular button labels. Keep the white background and card geometry. Do not add icons, chain symbols, artwork, extra labels, or decorative accents. Render a crisp flat UI screenshot, no device frame.
reviewNotes: User-directed revision: removed green and all tinted fills; only 説明を追加 is blue #1976D2 as requested. No other green/color accents. Needs-correction for oversized title and horizontal geometry drift versus native preview.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.purpose: User-directed revision after two earlier registrations: remove tints and green accents; retain blue hyperlink text.
